name: undertone
description: A quiet, floating desktop AI assistant for meetings, interviews, presentations and deep work.
author: Undertone contributors

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test:privacy: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/e2e/privacy.test.ts
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --platform win32
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --platform linux
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/e2e/provider.test.ts
